userRequest:
Build a Spring Boot 3.3 REST API for a small library management system.

Entities (JPA, H2 in-memory DB):
- Book: id, isbn, title, author, totalCopies, availableCopies
- Member: id, name, email (unique), joinedAt
- Loan: id, bookId, memberId, loanedAt, returnedAt (nullable)

Endpoints:
- Books: POST /api/books, GET /api/books, GET /api/books/{id}, PATCH /api/books/{id}, DELETE /api/books/{id}
- Members: POST /api/members, GET /api/members, GET /api/members/{id}
- Loans:
  - POST /api/loans/checkout — body {bookId, memberId}; creates a Loan, decrements availableCopies; 409 if none available
  - POST /api/loans/{id}/return — marks returnedAt=now, increments availableCopies; 409 if already returned
  - GET /api/loans?memberId= — lists a member's loan history

Constraints:
- Java 21, Spring Boot 3.3, Spring Data JPA, H2 runtime dep
- Use JDBC via Spring Data JPA (no raw JDBC templates)
- Constructor injection only — no @Autowired on fields
- Bean Validation (@Valid + @NotBlank / @Email) on request DTOs
- A GlobalExceptionHandler returning problem+json (status, error, message)
- Flyway migration V1__schema.sql for the three tables
- Include a README covering run instructions (mvn spring-boot:run) and example curl commands

{"totalLatencyMs":117675,"wiringPassSummary":"Found and fixed 1 critical wiring issue in this Spring Boot project:

**Issue:** Component scanning misconfiguration
- The main application class (XaiApplication) was in package `com.xai`
- All controllers (BookController, MemberController, LoanController), services (BookService, MemberService, LoanService), repositories (BookRepository, MemberRepository, LoanRepository), and exception handler (GlobalExceptionHandler) were in package `com.library`
- By default, @SpringBootApplication only scans its own package and subpackages, so the entire `com.library` package was never registered
- This would cause runtime failures: routes not served, services not autowired, repositories not available

**Fix:** Added @ComponentScan annotation to XaiApplication to explicitly include both packages:
```java
@ComponentScan(basePackages = {"com.xai", "com.library"})
```

This ensures all Spring-managed beans in both packages are properly discovered and registered at startup. Build verified successful.","generalPassSummary":"","overall":"FIXED_ISSUES","finalBuildExitCode":0,"finalBuildPassed":true}
